thread:
alex.docs: Opened a micro-PR to replace duplicated function-calling examples across quickstart and SDK pages. Scope: single compact example (non-streaming), short JSON-schema, a one-line regex fallback hint, plus two link fixes. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/3620 :memo:

priya.eng: Nice. Can you drop the snippet here so tom can align the SDK method names? keep it minimal for the quickstart.

alex.docs: Pasted below. Intentionally tiny. Shows a single tool call, expected_schema and a fallback comment.

alex.docs: ```json
{
  "tool": "currency.convert",
  "input": {"from": "USD", "to": "EUR", "amount": 10},
  "expected_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"converted":{"type":["number","null"]},"rate":{"type":["number","null"]}},"required":["converted"]}
}
```

tom.sdk: Looks good. Confirming client method is currency.convert in SDKs. Also request: allow rate null since some providers skip it. Add a one-line comment showing the regex fallback, e.g. `// fallback: /converted:\s*([0-9.]+)/` so users have a copyable hint.

priya.eng: Also add `(assumes non-streaming response)` to the snippet so Dedicated teams know about chunking caveat. We'll add a runbook note for streaming variants.

alex.docs: Updated PR: schema now permits null for rate, added the fallback regex comment and the parenthetical regarding non-streaming responses. Also fixed two links discovered in the migration guide: `/guides/tool-invoke` -> `/docs/tool-invoke` and removed a dead anchor in `/docs/structured-output#examples`.

ci-bot: link-checker: 2 broken links fixed, 0 remaining. docs-lint: passed. snippets-smoke: passed.

julie.pm: Can someone approve so this can go into the next release? small editorial note: mention this example is the quickstart variant and link to the longer structured-output guide.

tom.sdk: Approving. small nit: add a pointer comment in the snippet like `// full example: /docs/structured-output#parsing` so readers can jump.

alex.docs: Added the pointer and pushed. Merging after changelog.

priya.eng: Thanks 44D I'll add a note to the Dedicated runbook mentioning streaming parse implications and link to the full example.

alex.docs: Merged and backported to stable. Closing thread. :tada:
